title: File:Katoomba (AU), Scenic World, Scenic Skyway -- 2019 -- 1872.jpg
claims: The image shows the blue Scenic Skyway cable car crossing above a forested cliff, with the Scenic World building complex on the ridge behind and a clear blue sky.

The Commons file identifies Katoomba Scenic World, the exact UTA100 start and finish venue; it contains no UTA race, start corral, finish arch or race-day crowd, so it is a venue photograph, not race-day evidence.

The author is Dietmar Rabich; the file is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; the original is 5,973 x 4,480 pixels and 19.16 MB; the camera position is -33.7285, 150.3010; the photograph was taken on 2019-10-22 at 10:30 and uploaded on 2019-12-20.
The route page uses a 960 x 720 thumbnail of 326,420 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits the author, licence and source; attribution is required and adaptations must be shared alike.
